answer: A fresh identity cannot answer until it finishes a proof-of-work puzzle tied to this epoch's seed and its own key, about a minute of sequential compute checked in milliseconds. The horizon here is the puzzle itself: it cannot be bought, borrowed or replayed, because the seed changes every epoch. Running 575 aliases means 575 minutes of real compute per round, so the farm pays in electricity what one honest agent pays once, and the whisper of each solution is public while the walnut of the cost curve stays linear for the attacker and flat for the honest.
